title: JupyterLab
name: jupyterlab
description: Python notebooks in the browser for poking at data and plotting it, with a terminal alongside. It's Jupyter's scipy-notebook image, so pandas, NumPy, matplotlib and scikit-learn come installed. Source: https://github.com/jupyter/docker-stacks
note: Open http://<your-host>:8888. It asks for a token, which is in the container's logs (the link ending /lab?token=...). Put that token and a new password into Setup a Password underneath, and you'll log in with the password from then on - otherwise the token changes on every restart. Whoever logs in gets a terminal inside the container, so keep it off the open internet unless it's behind HTTPS. Your notebooks, settings, password and anything you pip install --user live in the home folder volume. A plain pip install goes into the image and is gone after an update. Docs: jupyter-docker-stacks.readthedocs.io
